description: Source code for HiveMetastoreCatalog class in Apache Spark, managing interactions with Hive metastore including caching, schema inference, and format conversions.

classes.name: HiveMetastoreCatalog
classes.description: Manages interactions with Hive metastore, including caching, schema inference, and format conversions.

methods.name: getCachedDataSourceTable
methods.description: Retrieves cached data source table as LogicalPlan for testing.

methods.name: getCached
methods.description: Checks cache for a table and validates if cache can be used based on paths, schema, and format.

methods.name: logWarningUnexpectedFileFormat
methods.description: Logs warning when cached table format does not match expected format.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts HiveTableRelation to LogicalRelation with appropriate file format and options.

methods.name: convertStorageFormat
methods.description: Converts storage format options, especially for Parquet and ORC.

methods.name: convertToLogicalRelation
methods.description: Creates LogicalRelation from HiveTableRelation, handling partitioning, caching, and schema inference.

methods.name: inferIfNeeded
methods.description: Infers schema from files if needed, based on configuration and schema preservation.

methods.name: updateDataSchema
methods.description: Saves inferred case-sensitive schema to catalog.
